goals.hint: Iron ingots around a diamond sword and a redstone block.
goals.why: Shreds feathers into meal.

goals.hint: Collect the 5 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the other hatchery items set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.text: Hatch eggs in a Hatchery Nest and make a Lucky Egg
goals.hint: A Nest hatches eggs; the Lucky Egg Machine turns 24 eggs and 2 plastic into a Lucky Egg with a random prize.
goals.why: Nesting Pens collect eggs, feathers and manure; the Nest hatches eggs; Lucky Eggs roll a random prize.
steps: Craft a Nest (hay bales) and right-click it with an egg. A mob sitting on it or a powered block above speeds it up.
Put a chicken in a Nesting Pen with an Animal Net: it collects eggs, feathers and manure.
Craft the Lucky Egg Machine (planks, egg, iron blocks, circuit board), power it (40 RF/t) and feed it 24 eggs and 2 plastic.

goals.hint: A Nest ringed by 7 planks.
goals.why: The pen keeps chickens next to their nest.

goals.hint: Iron ingot over an iron block, wooden slabs around it.
goals.why: Feeds the nests automatically.

goals.hint: Every Chickens item that unlocks in this age ticks by itself when you get it.
goals.why: Collect all of Chickens; each item below shows how to get it.

goals.hint: 6 iron around a piston with 3 wooden slabs below.
goals.why: Hatches the eggs inside a nest.

goals.hint: Collect the 3 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the other hatchery items set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: A Corn Cob in the crafting grid gives 2 Kernels.
goals.why: Kernels pop into Popcorn.
steps: Grow corn and pick the cobs.
Put 1 Corn Cob in the grid.

goals.hint: Plant kernels (from grass), harvest the cobs and cook them into roasted corn, popcorn or chowder.
goals.why: Another food crop used in many recipes.
steps: Break tall grass for corn kernels.
Plant them on farmland; corn grows two blocks tall.
Harvest the cobs and cook them.

obtain.sf3extras:corn_cob: Harvest grown corn. Plant kernels, which drop from tall grass.

goals.hint: Paper + Gunpowder + Popcorn: shapeless, gives 3 Firework Rockets.
goals.why: A cheap way to make rockets for elytra flight.
steps: Craft paper, gunpowder and popcorn together.

goals.hint: Smelt or smoke a Corn Cob.
goals.why: A cooked food.
steps: Put a Corn Cob in a furnace or smoker.

goals.hint: Bowl + Milk Bucket + 2 Corn Cobs: shapeless.
goals.why: A filling soup.
steps: Put a Bowl, a Milk Bucket and 2 Corn Cobs in the grid.

goals.hint: Bowl + Milk Bucket + Corn Cob + Cooked Chicken: shapeless.
goals.why: The bigger soup.
steps: Put a Bowl, a Milk Bucket, a Corn Cob and Cooked Chicken in the grid.

goals.hint: The Cooking Table lists every meal you can make from connected counters, fridges and jars.
goals.why: Shows what your stored ingredients can make and crafts it in one click.
steps: Place counters, a fridge and cabinets touching it; it reads their contents.

goals.hint: 3 stone over 5 terracotta and a wooden chest.
goals.why: Kitchen storage that links to the table.

goals.hint: 3 wooden slabs over 2 iron nuggets.
goals.why: Hangs kitchen tools on the wall.
steps: Tool Rack: 3 any wooden slabs + 2 any iron

goals.hint: Recipe Book turned into the unfiltered book.
goals.why: Shows every recipe with no ingredient filter.

goals.text: Make a dark room away from your base for spawning mobs and collecting loot
goals.hint: Mobs spawn in the dark: funnel them into one kill spot.
goals.why: Bones, string, gunpowder, ender pearls and XP on tap.
steps: Build an enclosed dark room (light 0) at least 24 blocks from where you stand.
Push mobs into one corner with water streams.
Drop them 22 blocks (or into a kill chamber) so one hit kills them.

goals.text: Move and damage mobs with Dark Utilities plates
goals.hint: Vector plates push mobs; damage plates hurt them; filters choose which mobs.
goals.why: Move mobs without water and kill them while you're away.
steps: Craft vector plates and damage plates.
Steer mobs with vector plates; put damage plates at the kill spot.

goals.hint: Stones around fence gates, with a golden pickaxe in the center.
goals.why: Filters let plates affect only chosen targets.

goals.hint: Ender pearl over a hopper between two obsidian.
goals.why: Pulls items from a distance.

goals.hint: Filters set which mobs a plate affects.
goals.why: Plates and hoppers can then target only animals, pets, undead and more.
steps: Put it in a plate or hopper.

goals.hint: Collect the 3 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the other dark utilities items set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: Collect the 16 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the colored slime blocks set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: Collect the 2 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the dark utilities charms set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: Collect the 2 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the pearl and wither dust blocks set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: Collect the 1 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the dark utilities chests set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: Collect the 12 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the plate filters set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.hint: Collect the 4 items of this family; each is a task row below.
goals.why: Completes the dark utilities traps set.
steps: Get each item from its recipe, drop or world source.

goals.text: Build an underground workshop connected to your home
goals.hint: Dig a lit, enclosed workshop next to or under your home.
goals.why: Later ages add many machines; keep mobs and creepers away from them.
goals.tip: Light stops normal spawns; spawners and some modded mobs ignore light.
steps: Dig a room under or beside your home with space for machines and cables.
Light the floor, seal the entrances and keep dangerous machines apart.
Connect it to your home with stairs or an elevator.

goals.hint: Stand on an elevator and jump to go up, sneak to go down.
goals.why: Instant travel between floors or down a mine shaft, no ladders or water.
steps: Craft two elevators (dye them any color).
Place them in one column, one per floor, with at least 2 air blocks above each.
Stand on one: jump to go up, sneak to go down.

goals.hint: 8 black dye around a white Elevator.
goals.why: Color-coded floors.

goals.text: Obtain Andesite Alloy for your first Create components
goals.hint: 2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets in a square = andesite alloy (or mix them in a Mechanical Mixer).
goals.why: Create is the pack's mechanical tech; andesite alloy makes shafts, cogwheels, casings, belts and most early machines.
goals.tip: Hold W over any Create item for a Ponder scene that shows how it works.
steps: Mine andesite (grey stone in caves and mountains).
Craft 2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets in a square, or mix them in a Mechanical Mixer.

goals.text: Make Shafts and Cogwheels to carry rotation
goals.hint: Shafts and cogwheels carry rotation to Create machines.
goals.why: Create machines run on rotation from a source.
steps: Craft shafts (andesite alloy) and cogwheels (shaft + planks).
Shafts connect end to end; cogwheels connect side by side and change direction.

goals.text: Build a Create water-wheel workshop and connect a machine to it
goals.hint: Flowing water over a water wheel makes rotation.
goals.why: Free, endless rotation for your first Create machines.
steps: Put it on a shaft with flowing water running over it (side or top).
Run shafts and cogwheels to a machine. More wheels add their stress capacity.

goals.hint: Apply an Andesite Alloy to a stripped log.
goals.why: Casing is the base of the Press, Mixer, Fan and most other machines.
steps: Strip a log with an axe.
Right-click the log with Andesite Alloy.

goals.text: Use a Mechanical Press to make a metal sheet
goals.hint: An ingot on a depot under a turning press becomes a sheet.
goals.why: Many Create recipes need iron, copper and gold sheets. Over a basin, the press compacts items.
steps: Craft the press and a depot.
Put the press 2 blocks above the depot and give it rotation.
Drop an ingot on the depot.

goals.text: Connect two Shafts with a Mechanical Belt
goals.hint: Use a belt connector on two shafts; belts carry items and rotation.
goals.why: Belts move items between machines: the backbone of every Create line.
steps: Right-click one shaft, then another in line (up to 20 blocks apart).

goals.hint: Cogwheel + Andesite Casing + stone: grinds items dropped on top.
goals.why: First ore doubler: grind ore and crops into dust.

goals.text: Wash gravel or crushed ore with an Encased Fan and water
goals.hint: A fan blowing through water washes items: gravel gives iron nuggets and flint.
goals.why: Crushed ore washes into extra nuggets; gravel into flint and iron nuggets (cheap renewable iron).
steps: Craft an encased fan and give it rotation.
Put water in front of it (flowing works).
Drop gravel or crushed ore into the air stream past the water.

goals.hint: 5 Andesite Alloy in a U shape: place it under a Mixer or Press.
goals.why: Holds the items and fluids that Mixers and Presses work on.
steps: Place it under a Mechanical Mixer.

goals.text: Combine ingredients with a Mechanical Mixer
goals.hint: A mixer above a basin combines items and fluids.
goals.why: Makes alloys, dough, chocolate and later brass.
steps: Place a basin, the mixer 2 blocks above it, and power the mixer.
Put ingredients in the basin; take outputs from it (or with a funnel).

goals.hint: Andesite Alloy + Iron Ingot + Andesite Casing: breaks blocks in front of it.
goals.why: Automatic mining face for stone and ore.
steps: Power it and point it at stone.

goals.hint: Iron Sheets + Iron Ingot + Andesite Casing: cuts logs.
goals.why: Automatic wood supply.
steps: Power it next to a tree or a log belt.

goals.hint: Andesite Alloy + Andesite Casing: a stand for one item.
goals.why: Holds items for a Deployer or Press in a processing line.

goals.text: Automate a useful material with Create machinery
goals.hint: Build a Create line for a material you keep running out of.
goals.why: Teaches belts, funnels and machines, and saves hours later.
steps: Pick a target: iron sheets, cobblestone (mechanical drill on a cobble generator), gravel, bread.
Feed inputs with funnels or a mechanical arm; send outputs to a chest.

goals.hint: Right-click a Shaft or Cogwheel with Andesite Casing.
goals.why: Hides shafts inside walls and lets one block carry rotation both ways.
steps: Right-click a placed Shaft, Cogwheel or Large Cogwheel.

goals.hint: Brown Toolbox is crafted; dye it for the other 15 colors.
goals.why: Carries a bag of tools and opens near you.
steps: Dye it with any dye for another color.

goals.text: Pack items into a Cardboard Package
goals.hint: Cardboard Packages are made by a Packager and hold a stack of items.
goals.why: Packages move items over chains and belts to other bases.

goals.text: Run Fluid Pipes with a Mechanical Pump
goals.hint: Fluid Pipe: Copper Sheet + Copper Ingot + Copper Sheet in a row. Mechanical Pump: Cogwheel + Fluid Pipe.
goals.why: Moves water, lava and honey between tanks, Spouts and Basins.
steps: Craft a Mechanical Pump and power it.
Place pipes between a source and a Fluid Tank.

goals.hint: Copper Sheet over a wooden Barrel over a Copper Sheet.
goals.why: Stores fluids; tanks stack into a boiler for steam.

goals.hint: Copper Casing over Dried Kelp: fills items and Basins with fluid.
goals.why: Fills buckets, bottles and honey for Simulated.
steps: Place the Spout above a Basin or Depot.

goals.hint: Copper Casing over Dried Kelp Block over Copper Sheet.
goals.why: Pumps or fills a whole pool of fluid.

goals.hint: Collect the 4 items listed below; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Collect the 4 items listed below; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Collect the 2 items listed below; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Craft or collect the remaining items available in Age 3; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Craft or collect the remaining items available in Age 3; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Craft or collect the remaining items available in Age 3; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Craft or collect the remaining items available in Age 3; each ticks on its own.
goals.why: Completes the family and unlocks its variants.
steps: Tick them off in the list below.

goals.hint: Every Create item that unlocks in this age ticks by itself when you get it.
goals.why: Collect all of Create; each item below shows how to get it.

goals.hint: Every Create item that unlocks in this age ticks by itself when you get it.
goals.why: Collect all of Create; each item below shows how to get it.

goals.text: Capture a structure with a Capsule
goals.hint: A Capsule packs a build into an item and unpacks it anywhere.
goals.why: Move a base or outpost in one go. Higher tiers need steel and vibrant alloy.
steps: Use it on the block you want to capture.

goals.text: Place Redstone Paste on a wall or ceiling
goals.hint: Redstone Paste sticks to walls and ceilings where dust cannot.
goals.why: Run signals up walls and across ceilings, which dust can't. Circuits stay small and hidden.
steps: Right-click the side of a block or a ceiling: the paste sticks there.
It connects like dust to neighbors on the same face.

goals.text: Power a redstone device through a Redstone Paste connection
goals.hint: Run paste up a wall to a lamp or door.
goals.why: Tests wall wiring: a lever at the floor lights a lamp near the ceiling.
steps: Place a lever at the bottom of a wall.
Run paste from the lever up the wall to a redstone lamp.
Flip the lever: the lamp lights up.

goals.hint: Repeater + slime ball: place it on a wall or ceiling.
goals.why: A repeater that sticks to any face.
steps: Craft a Repeater and a slime ball together.
Place it on a wall or ceiling.

goals.hint: Comparator + slime ball: place it on a wall or ceiling.
goals.why: A comparator that sticks to any face.
steps: Craft a Comparator and a slime ball together.
Place it on a wall or ceiling.

goals.hint: A gate outputs at the front and reads its sides: NAND, NOR, XOR, RS latch and more.
goals.why: One small block replaces a redstone-torch contraption.
steps: Place it: front = output; the sides (and back) = inputs.

goals.text: Use a Charset NAND Gate in a powered redstone circuit
goals.hint: Wire two levers into a NAND gate's sides and a lamp to its front.
goals.why: NAND is ON unless both inputs are ON; every other gate can be built from NANDs.
steps: Place the gate; the front is the output.
Wire a lever to each side and a lamp to the front.
Both levers on: the lamp turns off. Any other combination keeps it on.

goals.text: Rotate a Charset Gate with the Charset Wrench
goals.hint: The wrench rotates any block with a facing.
goals.why: Fixes a gate or machine placed the wrong way without breaking it and losing its settings.
steps: Right-click the gate or machine to turn it.

goals.hint: Craft an XOR or NOR gate and wire it beside a NAND.
goals.why: Lets you build any circuit from compact gates.
steps: Place it and rotate it with the Wrench.

goals.hint: Craft a Lock and fit it to a barrel.
goals.why: Keeps others out of your barrels; the matching Key opens it.

goals.text: Store items in a Simple Barrel
goals.hint: A wooden barrel holds lots of one item.
goals.why: Cheap bulk storage for seeds, cobblestone or dirt.
steps: Right-click with an item to store it; left-click takes a stack.

goals.text: Craft the ender, item frame, vacuum and Mark 1 upgrades
goals.hint: Barrel upgrade items.
goals.why: Barrel upgrades from the Simple Barrels mod.
steps: Craft each item listed in the tasks.

goals.text: Upgrade a drawer with a Storage Upgrade
goals.hint: Storage upgrades multiply a drawer's capacity.
goals.why: With upgrades one drawer holds thousands of items: a small wall stores a whole mine.
steps: Craft a storage upgrade (obsidian first, then iron, gold, diamond, emerald).
Open the drawer (sneak-right-click with an empty hand) and put the upgrade in an upgrade slot.

goals.hint: Use the key on a drawer to lock its contents or slots.
goals.why: Locked drawers keep their item type when emptied.
steps: Sneak-use it on a drawer or controller to change the lock.

goals.hint: Upgrade Template + redstone torches, sticks and redstone: put it in a drawer upgrade slot.
goals.why: Drawers show fill level and can emit redstone signals.
steps: Put it in a drawer upgrade slot.

goals.hint: Stone, comparators, a basic drawer and a gold ingot: extends a controller.
goals.why: Reaches drawers beyond one controller's range.
steps: Place it near distant drawers and link it to the controller.

goals.text: Craft the redstone, one stack and void drawer upgrades
goals.hint: Min, max and plain redstone, one stack and void upgrades.
goals.why: Upgrades for Storage Drawers.
steps: Craft each item listed in the tasks.

goals.text: Pair a Charset Key with a Charset Barrel
goals.hint: Right-click an unlocked barrel with a key to pair them.
goals.why: Keys and locks keep storage private on a shared server.
steps: Right-click an unlocked Charset barrel with it.

goals.text: Lock a Charset Barrel and unlock it with the matching key
goals.hint: Use the paired key to lock and unlock the barrel; a Master Key can bypass its lock.
goals.why: The lock stops normal access; claimed chunks are the real base protection.
goals.tip: A Master Key opens any Charset barrel: the lock is not owner-only security.
steps: Pair a key with the barrel (previous goal).
Lock it with the key and check the barrel won't open.
Unlock it with the same key. Keep a spare key safe.

goals.hint: The Master Key unlocks any locked Charset barrel.
goals.why: Recovers a barrel when the paired key is lost.
goals.tip: It bypasses every lock: keep it safe and rely on claims for protection.
steps: Use it on a locked Charset barrel.

goals.text: Craft and place a Charset Shelf
goals.hint: A shelf shows and stores six item stacks.
goals.why: Books, potions and trophies on display and in storage at once.
steps: Craft a shelf and place it on a wall or floor.
Right-click a slot to put the item in your hand there.

goals.text: Craft, wear and open a Charset Backpack
goals.hint: Right-click to wear it, then press B to open its 27 slots.
goals.why: 27 extra slots on your back.
steps: Right-click to wear it; press B to open it.

goals.hint: Use an Iron to Gold Upgrade on an iron chest.
goals.why: More slots again.

goals.text: Craft a Gold to Diamond Upgrade
goals.hint: Use it on a gold chest to make a diamond chest.
goals.why: The base for obsidian and crystal chests.
steps: Use it on a gold chest.

goals.text: Upgrade a chest to an Obsidian Chest
goals.hint: Upgrade chests in order: wood -> iron -> gold -> diamond -> obsidian.
goals.why: More space: an obsidian chest holds 108 stacks and resists explosions. Four Obsidian Chests go into the Quantum DSU.
steps: Craft the chest upgrades (wood to iron, iron to gold, gold to diamond, diamond to obsidian).
Right-click a placed chest with the upgrade; the contents stay.

goals.hint: Colossal Chest Wall + iron ingot: place it as the core of a wall box.
goals.why: The core block that makes the structure a chest.
steps: Build the wall box and place it on the shell.

goals.hint: Build a hollow cube of chest walls with a core in one wall; bigger cubes hold more.
goals.why: One giant chest: a 16x16x16 wooden one holds thousands of stacks.
goals.tip: Build a small one first to learn the structure.
steps: Get one Colossal Chest Core and wall blocks for a hollow 16x16x16 shell.
Build all six faces, floor and roof included; leave the inside empty.
Swap one wall block for the Core; add an Interface where automation connects.
Check the Core says the multiblock formed before filling it.

goals.hint: Use diamond walls and a diamond chest core.
goals.why: A higher tier holds more.
steps: Build the structure from diamond walls.

goals.hint: Obsidian walls for the obsidian Colossal Chest.
goals.why: The wall block of the obsidian tier.
steps: Craft each item listed in the tasks.

goals.hint: Copper, iron and gold interfaces.
goals.why: Interfaces connect pipes and hoppers to the chest.
steps: Craft each item listed in the tasks.

goals.hint: Interface for the netherite chest.
goals.why: Connects pipes to the netherite chest.
steps: Craft each item listed in the tasks.

goals.text: Carry a Void Cup to delete junk
goals.hint: Items put in the Void Cup are destroyed.
goals.why: Delete cobblestone, dirt and junk instead of dropping it (dropped items lag the server).
steps: Right-click to open it and put the junk in.

goals.hint: Not Enough Wands: places a layer of blocks on a wall or floor in one click.
goals.why: Big builds go fast.
steps: Right-click the face of a wall: it adds a layer from your inventory. Costs a little XP.

goals.hint: Put blocks in the chisel and pick a design.
goals.why: Hundreds of decorative stone, wood and glass variants.
steps: Right-click to open it, put blocks in and click a design: the whole stack converts.

goals.hint: Place the Auto Chisel, put a chisel and blocks inside.
goals.why: Chisels whole stacks without clicking.
steps: Put a chisel in and the blocks to convert.

goals.hint: Craft or collect each item; see its card for the recipe.
goals.why: 2 items in this family; each one is its own task.
steps: Craft or collect each item; see its card for the recipe.
Pick up or craft each item to tick its task.

goals.text: Carve a block with Chisels & Bits
goals.hint: Left-click a block with a chisel to remove tiny bits; place bits with right-click.
goals.why: Details at 1/16 block: furniture, window frames, trims, statues.
steps: Place a chiselable block and hold a Chisels & Bits tool.
Pick its edit mode (tool tooltip or Controls).
Remove a small region, collect the bits, then place bits to build your design.
Keep bits in a Bit Bag or Bit Drawer.

goals.hint: Wool around a bit: holds loose bits.
goals.why: Stores the bits you chisel off.
steps: Chisel a block to get a bit.
Craft the Bit Bag from wool and a bit.

goals.hint: Measure distances between blocks and bits.
goals.why: Plan builds to the bit.

goals.hint: Place it and fill it with bits.
goals.why: Bulk storage for bits.
steps: Place it and fill it with bits.

goals.hint: The Decomposer turns blocks into clay; the Decobench crafts decorations from it.
goals.why: Decocraft adds thousands of furniture and decoration models.
steps: Craft a Decomposer and a Decobench.
Put blocks in the Decomposer: they become decoration clay.
Spend the clay at the Decobench on furniture.

goals.hint: Wool over a Decobench over a stick.
goals.why: Picks up and rotates placed props.
steps: Use it on a placed prop.

goals.text: Hang Fairy Lights between two fences
goals.hint: Right-click a fence with the lights, then another fence.
goals.why: String lights for paths, trees, markets and parties.
steps: Right-click a fence post, walk to another fence and right-click it.
Right-click the string with dyes or lights to change it.

obtain.fairylights:hanging_lights: Craft hanging lights from string, lights and a pattern of dye; JEI shows the pattern.

goals.hint: Iron ingot + blue, yellow and red dye.
goals.why: The bulb for light strings.

goals.hint: Iron ingot + vines + iron ingot: makes 2 garlands.
goals.why: Decorative vine strings.

goals.hint: Hang it on a string.
goals.why: Another light for strings.

goals.text: Mix colors with Flat Colored Blocks
goals.hint: The paint mixer makes solid colored blocks.
goals.why: Exact colors for pixel art, signs and modern builds.
steps: Combine dyes and blocks (JEI lists every color).

goals.text: Build ramps and floors with the Platformer
goals.hint: The platformer makes ramps, floors and railings from planks.
goals.why: Wooden ramps, floors and railings for bridges, docks and stairs.
steps: Put planks in, pick a shape (ramp, floor, railing) and take the result.

goals.hint: Iron ingots, iron bars and red dye.
goals.why: Adjusts placed platforms.

goals.text: Decorate with Reliquia lanterns, candles and sword plinths
goals.hint: Colored iron and gold lanterns, candle holders and sword plinths.
goals.why: Colored lighting, and a plinth to display your best sword.
steps: Craft lanterns, candle holders or plinths.
Right-click a plinth with a sword to display it.

goals.hint: 2 iron ingots + 2 black stained glass + torch.
goals.why: Dark decorative lighting.

goals.text: Reliquia: particle cylinder to particle cylinder
goals.hint: Craft or collect each item; see its card for the recipe.
goals.why: 1 items in this family; each one is its own task.
steps: Craft or collect each item; see its card for the recipe.
Pick up or craft each item to tick its task.

goals.text: Fire Porcelain and build with Porcelain Bricks
goals.hint: Smelt unfired porcelain; dye it or make bricks.
goals.why: White or dyed bricks; porcelain also makes buckets and faucets.
steps: Craft porcelain bricks (dye them if you like).

goals.hint: Porcelain Bricks in a faucet pattern.
goals.why: A decorative faucet.

goals.text: Ceramics: black clay barrel to yellow clay barrel extension
goals.hint: Craft or collect each item; see its card for the recipe.
goals.why: 32 items in this family; each one is its own task.
steps: Craft or collect each item; see its card for the recipe.
Pick up or craft each item to tick its task.

goals.hint: Particle blocks give off fire, smoke, hearts, notes or sparkles.
goals.why: Decoration for fountains, fireplaces, shops and parties.
steps: Right-click it to cycle through the effects.

goals.text: Write a checklist on a Clipboard
goals.hint: A clipboard holds a to-do list you can tick off.
goals.why: Plans and shopping lists in-game.
steps: Right-click to open it and type a list.
Click a line to tick it off.

goals.text: Break glass without Silk Touch and collect Charset Glass Shards
goals.hint: Glass broken without Silk Touch drops shards.
goals.why: The shards craft back into glass.
steps: Break a glass block with your hand or a normal tool.
Pick up the shards that drop.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_glass_shard: Break a glass block without Silk Touch.

goals.text: Craft a Glass Block from three Glass Shards
goals.hint: 3 shards in a row = 1 glass block.
goals.why: Rebuilding windows never loses glass.
steps: Put three glass shards in a row in the crafting grid.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_glass_shard: Break a glass block without Silk Touch.

goals.text: Place a Charset Poster on a wall
goals.hint: Posters hang flat on a wall and show an item or map.
goals.why: Maps, items and art on a wall, without a frame.
steps: Place it on a solid wall and right-click it with an item or a map.

goals.text: Dye a minecart with a dye or Graphite
goals.hint: Right-click a minecart with a dye; the dye is not used up.
goals.why: Color-code minecarts by route.
steps: Place a minecart on a rail.
Right-click it with a dye or graphite; the dye is not used up.

goals.text: Knock back primed TNT without resetting its fuse
goals.hint: Hit lit TNT to push it away; the fuse keeps counting.
goals.why: A Charset tweak: hit lit TNT away from your walls.
steps: Far from your base, light a TNT block.
Hit the primed TNT: it flies away and the fuse keeps counting.

goals.text: Trigger the Zorro boost while falling toward a saddled horse
goals.hint: Fall more than two blocks onto a saddled horse and right-click it.
goals.why: A Charset stunt: land on your horse and it gets a speed boost.
steps: Tame and saddle a horse (saddles come from chests or fishing).
Jump from more than two blocks above it and right-click it while falling.

goals.text: Craft the Pulse Former and Multiplexer
goals.hint: Charset gate pulse former: craft 5 redstone + 3 cobblestone + stone slab.
goals.why: Pulse Former turns a level into a short pulse; Multiplexer picks one of two inputs.
steps: Charset gate pulse former: craft 5 redstone + 3 cobblestone + stone slab
Charset gate multiplexer: craft 4 redstone + 4 cobblestone + stone slab

goals.hint: Charset barrel cart: craft a Minecart + a Charset Barrel.
goals.why: A minecart that carries a barrel.
steps: Charset barrel cart: craft a Minecart + a Charset Barrel

goals.hint: Craft the Lexica (book + sapling): Botania's full manual. Mystical flowers give the petals.
goals.why: Botania is flower magic: mana, automation, tools and the Gaia Guardian boss.
steps: Find mystical flowers (glowing flowers in forests and plains) for petals.
Craft the Lexica from a book and a sapling.

goals.hint: Fill it with water, throw in petals and a seed: a special flower pops out.
goals.why: Every Botania flower, generating or functional, is made here.
steps: Fill it with a water bucket.
Throw in a recipe's petals, then a seed.

goals.hint: Make a magical flower in the apothecary and plant it.
goals.why: Generates mana for pools without hand-feeding.
steps: Brew a flower in the Petal Apothecary
Plant it next to a spreader

goals.text: Pure Daisy turns stone to living rock
goals.hint: Part of the Orechid: Ore from Stone route.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Orechid: Ore from Stone route; next: Orechid grows ore from stone with mana.

goals.text: Orechid grows ore from stone with mana
goals.hint: Part of the Orechid: Ore from Stone route.
goals.why: Link 2 of 3 of the Orechid: Ore from Stone route; next: Feed the ore to Tinkers or Create for rare metals.

goals.text: Create Livingwood and Livingrock with a Pure Daisy
goals.hint: Place logs or stone around a Pure Daisy and wait about a minute.
goals.why: Livingwood and livingrock build mana spreaders, pools and the runic altar.
steps: Make a Pure Daisy in the apothecary (4 white petals + seed).
Place it with logs or stone in the 8 blocks around it.

diagram.title: Pure Daisy
diagram.view: Top view
diagram.note: Any mix of logs and stone works.

obtain.minecraft:oak_log: Chop any tree; every kind of log works.
obtain.minecraft:stone: Smelt cobblestone in a furnace, or mine stone with a Silk Touch pickaxe.
obtain.botania:special_flower: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).
obtain.botania:special_flower|type=puredaisy: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).

goals.hint: Manasteel ingots + 2 livingwood twigs.
goals.why: A faster tool and the start of the Manasteel line.
steps: Infuse iron into Manasteel in a mana pool
Craft the pickaxe from Manasteel ingots and sticks

steps: Craft the Mortar (stone) and the Pestle.

steps: Right-click it with the incense a ritual needs (JEI or the Runic Tablet).

goals.text: Perform a ritual at the Roots Casting Altar
goals.hint: Three offerings on the altar, burning incense around it, then sneak-right-click the altar with an empty hand.
goals.why: Rituals change weather, heal, grow crops, summon creatures and make Roots items. The Runic Tablet (Roots guide) lists them.
steps: Craft the Casting Altar (verdant sprigs, poppy, rune stones, gold block) and the Runic Tablet.
Pick a ritual (JEI or the tablet): it lists three offerings, the incense and any standing stones.
Put the offerings on the altar, light braziers with the incense, build the standing stones if needed.
Sneak-right-click the altar with an empty hand: the ritual takes 10 seconds.

goals.text: Imbue a Roots staff with a spell
goals.hint: Stick + petal dust in the Imbuer = a staff that casts that spell.
goals.why: Spells heal, attack, grow plants and more at range. A staff has limited casts; the Crystal Staff holds several spells.
goals.tip: SkyFactory 3 Roots: no spell library, one spell per staff.
steps: Make a petal dust in the Mortar.
Craft the Imbuer (sticks, chiseled stone bricks); right-click a stick and the dust onto it.
After two seconds take the staff; right-click to cast. Terra (the bar above the hotbar) pays for it.

obtain.roots:staff: Made in the Imbuer: a stick and a petal dust become a one-spell staff.

goals.hint: An Elder Guardian opens Age 4 (Nether & Power) for everyone on the server.

Age 4 brings the Nether, Immersive Engineering steel, Ender IO, Actually Additions, Extra Utilities generators, Refined Storage, RFTools, Steve's Carts, Blood Magic, Industrial Foregoing and the first TaCZ guns.

Bring: a Tinkers or diamond weapon, good armor and food. Elder Guardian: milk against Mining Fatigue and a Water Breathing potion. Wroughtnaut: hit it from behind after it swings.

goals.why: Early FE before a real power plant.

goals.text: Apply the Engineer Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Engineer tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 3 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Engineer page: Age 3 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: You get the Engineer Decree when Age 4 opens (every player gets one).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Engineer tab (left edge).
Place the decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Use the Engineer Decree on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Every player gets the Engineer Decree when Age 4 opens. On a board it offers Age 3 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one. Bounties count for this decree until the next decree arrives.
steps: Craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Engineer Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.hint: Build a 4x5 obsidian frame and light it with flint and steel.
goals.why: Blaze rods, quartz, glowstone, nether wart, wither skeletons and ancient debris: many mods need Nether materials.
goals.tip: Beds explode in the Nether: respawn with your Overworld bed.
steps: Get 10 obsidian and build the upright portal frame.
Light the inside with Flint and Steel.
Bring blocks, food and fire resistance if you have it. Mark the portal when you arrive.
Secure the return portal before exploring.

diagram.title: Nether portal

obtain.minecraft:obsidian: Pour water onto still lava and mine it with a diamond pickaxe, or pour water into a Stone Barrel full of lava.

goals.hint: Connectors in nether woods.

goals.why: Manyullyn is a top tier tool metal.

goals.text: Find a Nether Fortress and collect Blaze Rods
goals.hint: Fortresses are long dark-brick bridges; blazes spawn at their spawners.
goals.why: Blaze rods make brewing stands, blaze powder, eyes of ender and many machines. Wither skeletons (for the Wither) live in fortresses too.
steps: Travel along one axis (east or west) until you find dark red brick bridges.
Find a blaze spawner (a cage with fire) and fight blazes with a shield or bow.
Snowballs hurt blazes; fire resistance makes it much safer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter for a blaze farm.

goals.text: Brew a Potion of Fire Resistance
goals.hint: Brewing stand: nether wart in water bottles, then magma cream.
goals.why: Immunity to fire and lava: for the Nether, blaze farms, the Twilight Fire Swamp and the Hydra.
steps: Craft a brewing stand (blaze rod + cobblestone) and fuel it with blaze powder.
Brew nether wart (from a fortress) into water bottles: Awkward Potion.
Add magma cream (slime + blaze powder) for Fire Resistance; redstone makes it last longer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter for a blaze farm.

goals.hint: Invisible block you can stand on.
goals.why: Hidden bridges and floors.
steps: Place it where you need a hidden floor.

goals.text: Find a Bastion and trade with Piglins
goals.hint: Wear one gold armor piece and throw gold ingots to piglins to barter.
goals.why: Piglins trade ender pearls, obsidian, fire resistance potions, quartz and more for gold. Bastions hold netherite and gold loot.
steps: Wear at least one gold armor piece so piglins stay calm.
Throw a gold ingot to a piglin (Q) and pick up what it gives back.

mobs.where: Piglins live in Crimson Forests and the Nether Wastes and guard Bastions. Wear at least one piece of gold armor so they stay calm, then throw them gold ingots to barter.

goals.text: Ride a Strider across a lava ocean
goals.hint: Saddle a Strider and steer it with warped fungus on a stick.
goals.why: Striders carry you safely across lava.
goals.tip: Boats don't cross lava. Keep a marked way back.
steps: Bring a saddle, warped fungus on a stick, spare blocks and fire resistance.
Find a Strider by a lava sea, saddle it and mount it.
Steer with the warped fungus on a stick and get off on solid ground.

goals.text: Bring a Blaze Spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter
goals.hint: Only the diamond Chest Transporter picks up spawners (SF3 setting); the spawner keeps its mob.
goals.why: A blaze spawner at home is an endless blaze rod farm (brewing, eyes of ender, Create brass).
steps: Clear the blazes around a fortress spawner and right-click the spawner with the transporter.
Place it at home in a dark, enclosed room with a kill spot.

goals.text: Grow Natura Nether trees and berries
goals.hint: Sift soul sand for Natura Nether saplings and berries.
goals.why: Natura trees don't generate in this pack; sieving is how you get them.
steps: Collect soul sand in the Nether.
Pick the soul-sand sieve recipe and mesh in JEI for the sapling or berry you want.
Plant it on its soil with clear space around it, then harvest and replant.

goals.text: Craft and power a generator of some kind
goals.hint: Simple Generators burn fuel, food or lava and charge machines next to them.
goals.why: Most tech machines run on FE/RF: a generator starts every tech path.
steps: Craft a Furnace Generator or any other generator.
Fuel it with coal or charcoal.
Put a machine next to it, or connect conduits or cables.

goals.hint: Fuel a Survival or Furnace Generator for FE.
goals.why: Machine power. Grid Power (GP), used by mills and some utility blocks, is separate.
steps: Craft a Survival or Furnace Generator.
Fuel it and connect an FE cable or a machine next to it.
Check power reaches the machine (GP mills don't supply FE).

goals.hint: Lava in, power out. Built around a Furnace Generator.
goals.why: The second SF3 generator: steady power from crucible or pumped lava.
steps: Craft it from gold, a lava bucket, redstone and an Extra Utilities Furnace Generator.
Pipe or bucket lava in; connect a machine or cable.

goals.text: Build Solar Panels from Solar Flux
goals.hint: Panels make power in daylight; touching panels share it.
goals.why: Free daytime power, no fuel. Higher tiers make much more.
steps: Place them under open sky, touching each other.
Connect one panel to a battery or machines; a battery covers the night.

goals.hint: Solar cell: the part that steps panels up a tier.
goals.why: Cells go into the higher panel tiers.
steps: Craft the next cells as you need them.

goals.hint: Blank upgrade: the base for every panel upgrade.
goals.why: Upgrades add capacity, transfer rate, traversal and low light.
steps: Craft a capacity or transfer upgrade from it.

goals.hint: Solar cells 2 to 4 go into the upper panels.
goals.why: Gates the top panels.
steps: Solar Cell2: 3 clay ball + 3 lapis + 2 mirror + solar cell1.
Solar Cell3: 3 glass blocks + 3 glowstone + 2 obsidian + solar cell2.
Solar Cell4: 3 blaze rod + 2 glowstone + diamond + 2 quartz + solar cell3.

goals.hint: Upgrades snap into a panel's slots.
goals.why: Capacity, transfer rate, low light, traversal and furnace smelting.
steps: Upgrade Capacity: 5 redstone + upgrade blank + diamond.
Upgrade Furnace: 7 coal + upgrade blank + furnace.
Upgrade Low Light: 6 glass blocks + 2 glowstone + upgrade blank.
Upgrade Transfer Rate: 6 redstone + 2 gold + upgrade blank.
Upgrade Traversal: 4 iron + 2 redstone + upgrade blank.

goals.hint: Wires link panels to a machine.
goals.why: Carry panel power to machines.

goals.hint: Tier 2, 5 and 6 panels.
goals.why: Fill in the panel ladder.
steps: Solar4: 3 solar cell3 + 4 solar3 + glowstone + gold.
Solar5: 3 solar cell4 + 4 solar4 + redstone lamp + diamond.

goals.hint: Higher panel tiers make more RF per tick.
goals.why: More power per tile means fewer starved machines.
steps: Place it with open sky above.

goals.text: Craft the Machine Frame and base parts
goals.hint: Machine Frame and Machine Base are the shell of most RFTools machines.
goals.why: Nearly every machine below starts from the frame.
steps: Machine Frame: 4 iron ingot + 2 blue + 2 gold nugget.
Infused Enderpearl: 8 dimensional shard + ender pearl.
Dimensional Shard. (6 more in this group)

goals.text: Store power in an RFTools Power Cell
goals.hint: Power cells store energy. Every side starts off: set them with a wrench.
goals.why: Stores generator overflow and keeps machines running at night or while generators refuel.
goals.tip: A new cell stays empty until its sides are set.
steps: Craft a power cell and place it between generators and machines.
Hit a side with a wrench (RFTools Smart Wrench or any wrench) to cycle it: input, output, off.
Sides at generators or cables: input. Sides feeding machines: output.

goals.text: Build the Culinary Generator and its upgrades (Age 4)
goals.hint: Culinary Generator burns food; tier 2 and 3 are upgrades.
goals.why: Turns spare food into power.
steps: Culinary Generator: 4 stone + 3 gold ingot + furnace + redstone block.

goals.text: Make a basic Ender IO capacitor and a Machine Chassis
goals.hint: Basic capacitor: copper, redstone, gold nuggets. Machine Chassis: iron bars and iron around a capacitor.
goals.why: Core ingredients of every Ender IO machine.
steps: Craft a Basic Capacitor (copper ingots, redstone, gold nuggets).
Craft the Machine Chassis: iron bars and iron ingots around the capacitor.
Build an Ender IO machine with it (the Alloy Smelter first) and power it.

goals.text: Make alloys in an Alloy Smelter
goals.hint: The alloy smelter makes electrical steel and the other Ender IO alloys.
goals.why: Ender IO machines, capacitors and conduits need its alloys (electrical steel, energetic alloy, conductive iron...).
steps: Power it; fill its three input slots (JEI lists every alloy).

goals.hint: Iron Ingot + Copper Ingot in an Alloy Smelter.
goals.why: Used in chargers and upgrades.

goals.hint: Part of the Zinc for Create brass route.
goals.why: Link 1 of 3 of the Zinc for Create brass route; next: Silk-touch the ore and double it in the Ender IO SAG mill: 2 crushed zinc per ore.

goals.text: Automate turning Cobblestone into Gravel with a SAG Mill or Auto Hammer
goals.hint: The SAG Mill crushes cobblestone into gravel and doubles ore; the Auto Hammer is a powered hammer.
goals.why: Ore crushed into two dusts doubles your metal; gravel feeds the sieves.
steps: Craft a SAG Mill or an Auto Hammer.
Power it and feed cobblestone or ore; take output with a hopper or conduit.

goals.text: Use Ender IO Conduits to power several machines at once
goals.hint: One conduit block carries power, items, fluids and redstone.
goals.why: A tidy workshop: one line for everything.
steps: Run a line from a generator past your machines; it connects to each.
Add item and fluid conduits into the same blocks later.

goals.hint: 4 Iron Ingot + 4 Basic Capacitor + Redstone Block.

goals.text: Make Steel with a Coke Oven and Blast Furnace
goals.hint: Coke oven: coal into coal coke. Blast furnace: iron + coke into steel.
goals.why: Immersive Engineering and many other machines need steel; coal coke is a strong fuel.
steps: Craft the Engineer's Hammer and read the Engineer's Manual.
Build a 3x3x3 cube of 27 Coke Bricks and hit the middle of a side with the hammer.
Burn coal into coke. Build a 3x3x3 Blast Furnace (27 blast bricks) and smelt iron with coke into steel.

diagram.title: Coke Oven
diagram.view: A solid 3x3x3 cube of Coke Bricks; hit the middle of one side with the hammer.
diagram.note: The Blast Furnace is the same cube made of Blast Bricks.

goals.text: Build and power an Immersive Engineering Crusher

goals.why: Crushes ores and other materials (metal equipment recycling is the Arc Furnace's job).
steps: Build the Crusher multiblock shown in the Engineer's Manual.
Hit the marked trigger block with the Engineer's Hammer.
Connect FE and put storage at the output.
Feed items into the top and collect the result. Stay out of the machinery.

obtain.immersiveengineering:crusher: Not crafted: build the multiblock shown in the Engineer's Manual and hit it with the Engineer's Hammer.

goals.text: Assemble a Simulated Contraption with a Physics Assembler
goals.hint: Glue blocks together, put a Physics Assembler on them and pull its lever: they become a physics object.
goals.why: Create Aeronautics builds real vehicles with weight and momentum; you can stand on them, and chests and machines on board keep working.
goals.tip: Every block has a mass (F3+H shows Sable Mass): wood is light, iron and stone heavy. A slime ball merges two contraptions.
steps: Craft a Physics Assembler: lever over brass casing, andesite alloy on both sides.
Build a small platform and put the assembler on top (it grabs the block under it).
Use Super Glue (or Honey Glue) on two corners to select every block of the contraption.
Hold right-click on the assembler and pull the lever: the blocks lift off and get physics.
Use any Physics Assembler on it again to turn it back into blocks.

diagram.title: A first contraption
diagram.view: Layers from the bottom: a plank platform with the assembler on top
diagram.note: Glue the whole platform before you pull the lever. Pieces that are not connected split off as their own contraption.
